The 2027 player option switched to a club option at the same value because Pivetta spent at least 130 consecutive days on the injured list within a season (2026) for a "qualifying injury," the specifics of which are unknown, but it has been reported his 2026 elbow injury qualifies. If between 2026-07-01 and the end of 2028, Pivetta spent at least 130 consecutive days on the injured list for the same qualifying injury, the club will have a $5M option for 2029
